title: Consolidated root theorem for P104: chain-nested optimality with rigidity, the cost formula, dense supports and the one-extra-unit floor, under an explicit hypothesis ledger (no κ)
body:
**Claim.** Research package `research/p104-consolidated-root-theorem` (builds on #6868, the chain-nested root of #6833). Under a stated model and an explicit hypothesis ledger, `chain(9|9)` minimises `D_root = f(8L+1) + sum[f(8|M|+1) - sum f(8r)]` (`f = x ln x`, `1418.8458829` per port at `L = 18`) among shortest roots. Included: Dieudonne `N >= n+1` with a direct rigidity proof (no Katz theorem; char != 2 automatic over `Z[1/2][i]`); star optimality for `N = 2..1199`; the block-partition S identity (all 384 partitions of 18, best -4.8%); the cost formula derived from the #6833 invoice to 1e-40 (exact kernel rescales `D_root` by -0.78%, optimiser unchanged); dense x and y (exact `L <= 8`, all `L` for single-host fields); roots with one extra unit (floor 1276.0 against break-even 1120.2, under R1-R4); D-free bases as a verifier convention with D-jobs priced. No kappa claim, no word.

**Scope (open assumptions and items).**
- Assumed: rank-one units; each `D_k` once and affine; `[P_k, U_k] = 0` and `x_k, y_k` inside `M_k` in the site frame; liveness R4; D-free bases (verifier convention); the whole-job/compiler contract behind the cost formula; quoted constants (`S = 760`, native total).
- Twisted site-frame masks: not forced by the verifier's rules; closed at `L = 2` (no twisted root below 90.854 against 87.7147; twisted sites with `|S| = 2` do not exist, Groebner basis `{1}` over Q); open for `L >= 4`.
- Shared-host fields and pivot rows at `L >= 10`: proved only for single-host fields (all L) and exact up to `L = 8`.
- Roots with `e >= 2` extra units, and `e = 1` with R2/R3 dropped; the `e = 1` floor needs R1-R4.
- J-staircase lemma (constant bases plus uncredited D-jobs): priced with no gain, not proved.
- Outside the model: non-coordinate masks, rank-2 units, non-gadget implementations, border and scratch-clearing escapes.

**How to verify.** `python3.12 -I -B research/p104-consolidated-root-theorem/check.py` (about 25 s, standard library only; prints `PASS_P104_CONSOLIDATED_ROOT_THEOREM`; `--twisted` adds two Groebner decisions, needs Singular). Registered check: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-consolidated-root-theorem` prints `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`.
